name: dokploy-cli-action
description: GitHub Action wrapping the official Dokploy CLI. The pinned @dokploy/cli version is what the action runs; Dependabot bumps it.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --allowImportingTsExtensions --module nodenext --target es2023 --strict --erasableSyntaxOnly --skipLibCheck --types node src/*.ts test/*.ts
